svg.aria-label: Model 1987 · turret board layout (derived) — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: Redrawn from Marshall model 1987 factory drawing (Unicord 70-19-11, July 1970) — layout derived from this schematic; no factory layout sheet located — not a trace

Heater layer: the one part of this board not established against the amplifier's own drawing. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. Which sockets sit on the chain,
and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
